issue_1_threshold_selection.root_cause: Original implementation used in-sample training predictions in _calibrate_threshold_on_train.
issue_1_threshold_selection.correction: Generated 5-fold Stratified Out-of-Fold cross-validation predictions strictly on training pool to select threshold tau.
issue_1_threshold_selection.leakage_verification: ZERO test data accessed during threshold selection.

issue_2_before_after_comparison.root_cause: 218 of 1,215 test samples (17.94%) were present in the historical Phase 6.5/8 few-shot adaptation pool.
issue_2_before_after_comparison.verdict: BEFORE COMPARISON: INVALID — TEST SET APPEARED IN PREVIOUS TRAINING
issue_2_before_after_comparison.correction: Comparison figure and narrative updated to flag historical baseline as contaminated and prevent false improvement claims.

issue_3_zero_support_classes.root_cause: LOCATION class has 0 true examples in locked 20% test partition due to total corpus sparsity (9 samples total across 15 speakers).
issue_3_zero_support_classes.reporting_policy: Support = 0, Recall = N/A — no true examples in test set, Precision = N/A, F1 = N/A.
issue_3_zero_support_classes.macro_f1_policy: Canonical Macro-F1 averages across all 7 classes (/7) with zero_division=0. Supported-class Macro-F1 averages across 6 supported classes (/6).

definitions.canonical_iper: TP / (TP + FN) (emergency utterances preserved as any emergency)

issue_4_emergency_metric_definitions.discrepancy_explanation: Low precision (7.43%) and low FER (11.86%) naturally coexist due to extreme class imbalance: 4.94% emergency prevalence means 137 false alarms over 1,155 general speech samples overpower 11 true alarms over 60 emergencies.

final_scientific_verdict: CASE B CONFIRMED: NO STATISTICALLY SUPPORTED QUANTUM ADVANTAGE.
